page.overview:
Who is Airshow Tour Guide?

The airshow tour guide gives tours around the airshow at the U.S. Air Force Base. He directs the crowd's attention to a specific plane which has five tires, much to Marge's amazement. He says that it's so well-designed that even a child could fly it, but when Bart Simpson asks if he can fly it, he responds in the negative.
